decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: Count the original Quito Metro Line 1 once between Quitumbe and Labrador. Do not count its fifteen stations, maintenance contracts or proposed La Ofelia extension as additional projects. Quito's metropolitan municipality is a separate place identity, and no national acquisition docket is reused to manufacture a second project count.

Count the named Line 2 concession with its contracted Line 4 branch once, preserving the distinction between the five operating stations and remaining works. The branch is not the entire future Line 4, and each stage, tunnel section, station or city district is not a new project. No existing national acquisition docket is reused.

Count Quito once as the metropolitan district rather than only its metro corridor or the wider Pichincha province. Urban and rural parish examples remain inside that one place account. Do not turn the water portfolio, individual titles, childcare centres or forty-three reported local works into extra project/place identities or reuse a historical country docket.

review_checks: Identity screening found no existing Quito Metro, Lima–Callao Line 2 or Quito municipal dossier. Count two projects and one metropolitan district. Stations, construction stages, water works and educational centres do not create additional identities; no historical acquisition docket is reused.

Eighteen official Spanish sources were inspected November 22: thirteen HTML bodies or scoped segments and five official indexed records after direct retrieval failure. Interpretation is author/AI self-review, not independent language or subject review.

Three articles contain eighteen sections and nineteen chronology events, with five source-bound sections and one labelled editorial evidence test each. No translated-reading identity or Phase 60 identity is added.

Quito's opening report is dated December 5, 2023, and reports December 1 operation. Direct retrieval timed out; the official indexed account was used. The fifteen-station operating line excludes the proposed La Ofelia extension.

Quito's 173,281,818 cumulative trips through September 30 and 5,604,799 September trips are journeys, not unique people. Zero-valued peak/station homepage widgets and the linked bulletin were not used.

The May release's January–April 21.6 million trips and April 434-user survey retain their distinct periods and populations. Survey ratings do not establish equipment availability or independent safety. Its April communications suspension and wheel-reprofiling adjustments are not hidden by the positive ratings.

The maintenance page displays February 11 and 12, 2025 without clear separate roles. Publication is retained at month precision, not assigned an invented exact day. October 2024 defects, speed precautions and planned February repair/testing are historical; neither completion nor continued non-repair is inferred.

Reported USD 80 million CAF backing and four proposed stations are not disbursement, accepted works or service. The source's inconsistent elapsed-operating-years wording is excluded and does not override the dated December 2023 opening.

Quito's October 7 service-page update retains August reference frequencies and an advertised terminal journey. These are not observed November headways, measured end-to-end household journeys or a promise for a specific trip. Interactive selectors and linked PDFs were not tested.

Lima's single concession contains 27 km of Line 2 and an 8 km Line 4 branch, not the entire future Line 4. The five-station first stage opened December 21, 2023. USD 4,531 million is an investment commitment excluding IGV, not final expenditure; projected demand and design automation are not current outcomes.

The July 2 excavation-completion report supersedes undated project-page prospective tunnel wording. Publication is the report date, not an invented exact breakthrough day. Civil excavation does not establish integrated tests, accepted systems or passenger opening.

The Ositrán August 4 source was read as official indexed text after HTTP 418. Stage 1B, stage 2 and branch percentages have separate scopes; 2029/2030 opening dates remain forecasts. No full live-page inspection or acceptance certificate is claimed.

The June 30 card notice was inspected as official indexed text after timeout; its retrospective July 8 wording may reflect later editing. Publication and effective dates remain separate. The S/7.50 card purchase is not a journey fare. Conflicting cumulative passenger counts from other cutoffs were excluded.

The November 18 card-personalization restoration is a separately dated indexed notice, not restoration of the railway or a measured interruption duration. No later archive notice is borrowed as current evidence.

Lifts, tactile paving and assistance described by the operator do not establish a live accessible route. No telephone call, station inspection or individual travel assessment occurred. The congressional visit is not independent causal review of delays or a technical acceptance decision.

Quito's May 4 publication reports May 2 completion of a 42-metre raw-water canal repair. One component's completion does not measure all household continuity or drinking-water quality. The January nine-project portfolio mixes studies, procurement and works; its indicative USD 100 million is not secured financing or delivered treatment.

The July 15 official indexed account reports 524 assigned educational places, not attendance or universal access. Direct retrieval timed out; ambiguous wider centre totals were excluded. Proximity and vulnerability criteria do not establish any individual's entitlement.

The November municipal title count of 9,574 across 313 settlements is a program claim over a little more than three years, not an independently audited registry or newly built homes. No individual property query or legal determination occurred. February's forty-three local works remain examples in one place; inconsistent cost-table formatting was not summed and publication was not assigned as the ceremony's exact day.

Linked files, forms, maps, PDFs and live services were not tested. All prior cohorts, 34 readings and evidence decisions remain intact. Production verification, release authority, launch and thirty real operating days remain separate.
